title: 第二十一章 大权无冕第二十二章 普朗克
content_zh:
灰核城，南区，码头商业街。
王庆忽略了手机上的两条未接来电，在一家便利店门口玩着抓娃娃机，通过摇杆操纵机械爪去抓毛绒玩偶。
但是机械爪抖得厉害，每次王庆夹住了，一个大地震就给抖下去。
“套路真多啊。”
王庆瞟了一眼便利店的柜员，确认没在看着这边后，操控灵炁避过机器的简易侦测警报手段，自己把一个毛绒玩偶给夹了出来。
俯下身子把战利品拿起，是一只小狗玩偶，他觉得这玩意儿和自己以前一只灵宠刚捡到的时候有点像。
旋即放进了书包内。
现在过去还太早了。
王庆需要真正能堪大用的人，是什么资质都无所谓，有的是办法让他们变强。
他要的也不是钱，而是要打造“帝国”。
方舱的统治者相当高明。
自己目前的认知也被局限在“21层”内，不知全貌。
方舱公民居然大多数都对自由平等的共和深信不疑，最高明的操作是偷换概念，令人自己控制自己。
垄断经济会造成贫困，垄断权力会让人软弱，垄断信息则会令人无知。
三者兼具，反常识的是不会有人造反，反而会唱感恩的心。
这些人生于笼中，死于笼中，自戕其性。
大权无冕，大刑无形。
已近乎天道。
前世为至尊极境的王庆都觉得有点妖孽，无数人脑海里同时存在互相矛盾的观点无时无刻不在左右互博，但到最后都会得到天庭议会想要的最终结论。
所谓的天庭议会真有点东西，所以他也相当谨慎。

方舱不是很正能量啊，我真要好好控制你一下了。
他现在离交易地点就五公里的距离，但王庆并不打算过去，反而是找了个大排档坐下，点了点肉串。
来这里吃烧烤的都是码头的力工，王庆一个学生模样的人有些扎眼。
但是王庆并不在乎，打开手机，玩起了线上赌城，下午赚了十多万外快，必须好好操作操作。
对他人来说，王庆自然也是人脉，但前提是，自身必须有能承接或置换相应资源的条件。
道上不怕死的人也挺多，但那说明不了什么，在危机关头还能展现出魄力和器量，才称得上强者。
袁金刚一伙人之所和王庆结识，是因为催债，知道王庆的真名，学校，家庭，所有基本信息。
今晚上如果没死挨了下来，还有保密意识，比起怕死更怕自己，具备契约精神，那么能堪大用，重点培养。
都死了的话，也是一大幸事。
王庆会只留下萧肃一个活口，以全新的形式，打造生产贩卖的商业帝国，也抓住这些医疗公司的把柄，逐步蚕食上层权力，直逼中央的天庭议会。
人粹已是属于魔道范畴，但在天庭议会的法律中却依然有回旋空间，那么说明天庭中人，需要这个的也大有人在。
看服务生上了一瓶啤酒。
“我没点。”
王庆无语。
“这个是赠品，来消费的都有。”
服务生回应道。
“叔叔我啊，是未成年人，不能喝酒。”
王庆知道方舱的法律，贩卖给未成年人酒水虽然问题不大，不属于刑事案件，但也是违反治安管理条例的。
但面对睿智言论，服务生根本不碉他，爱勾吧喝不喝。
content_en:
Gray Core City, South District, Pier Commercial Street.
Wang Qing ignored the two missed calls on his mobile phone and played with a claw machine at the entrance of a convenience store, using the joystick to control the mechanical claw to catch plush dolls.
But the mechanical claw shook violently. Every time Wang Qing clamped it, a big earthquake shook it.
"There are so many tricks."
Wang Qing glanced at the convenience store teller, and after confirming that he was not looking at him, he controlled Lingqi to avoid the machine's simple detection alarm, and took out a plush doll by himself.
He leaned down and picked up the trophy. It was a puppy doll. He felt that this thing was a bit similar to the one he had picked up when he first picked up a spiritual pet.
He immediately put it into his schoolbag.
It's too early to pass now.
Wang Qing needs people who can really be used. It doesn't matter what qualifications they have, there are always ways to make them stronger.
What he wants is not money, but to build an "empire."
The ruler of the cabin is quite clever.
My current knowledge is also limited to the "21st floor" and I don't know the whole picture.
It turns out that most Fangcang citizens firmly believe in a republic of freedom and equality. The most clever operation is to secretly change the concept and let people control themselves.
A monopoly economy creates poverty, monopoly power makes people weak, and monopoly information makes people ignorant.
Combining all three, contrary to common sense, no one will rebel, but will sing with a grateful heart.
These people were born in cages and died in cages, killing themselves.
Great power has no crown, and great punishment is invisible.
It's close to the way of heaven.
Wang Qing, who was in the Supreme Realm in his previous life, felt that he was a bit of a monster. Countless people had conflicting opinions in their minds at the same time, exchanging opinions all the time, but in the end they would reach the final conclusion that the Heavenly Court wanted.
The so-called Heavenly Parliament is really something, so he is also very cautious.
Fangcang is not very positive. I really need to control you.
He was now only five kilometers away from the trading place, but Wang Qing had no intention of going there. Instead, he found a food stall to sit down and ordered some meat skewers.
The people who come here to have barbecue are all workers from the dock, and Wang Qing, a student-looking person, is a bit eye-catching.
But Wang Qing didn't care. He turned on his mobile phone and played online casino. He made more than 100,000 yuan in extra money in the afternoon, so he must operate it carefully.
For others, Wang Qing is naturally a human connection, but the premise is that he must have the conditions to take over or replace the corresponding resources.
There are quite a few people on the road who are not afraid of death, but that doesn't mean anything. Only those who can show courage and courage in times of crisis can be called strong.
Yuan Jingang and his gang got acquainted with Wang Qing because of debt collection and knew Wang Qing's real name, school, family, and all basic information.
If you survive tonight without death, have a sense of confidentiality, are more afraid of yourself than fear of death, and have a spirit of contract, then you can be of great use and focus on training.
It would be a great blessing if they were all dead.
Wang Qinghui left only Xiao Su alive to build a business empire of production and sales in a new form. He also seized the leverage of these medical companies and gradually eroded the power of the upper class, approaching the Central Heavenly Parliament.
Human essence already belongs to the category of magic, but there is still room for maneuver in the laws of the Heavenly Court. This means that there are many people in the Heavenly Court who need this.
Watch the waiter serve a bottle of beer.
"I didn't order it."
Wang Qing was speechless.
"This is a gift for everyone who comes to consume it."
the waiter responded.
"Uncle, I am a minor and cannot drink."
Wang Qing knew the laws of Fangcang. Although selling alcohol to minors was not a serious problem and was not a criminal case, it was still a violation of public security regulations.
But in the face of wise words, the waiter didn't judge him at all, whether he wanted to drink or not.
